concerns.text: SC-003 requires attribution scores to be validated against independent physical measurements, but the only verification in T008 checks that ≥ 80 % of top‑10 nodes belong to conjugated substructures, which does not satisfy the external validation requirement.

SC-004 mandates that the end‑to‑end pipeline complete within the 6‑hour GitHub Actions limit, yet no task explicitly measures or asserts total runtime; the closest verification (e.g., T006) only caps training time per run.
SC-005 requires peak RAM usage to stay below 7 GB, but none of the listed tasks record or enforce a memory‑usage check.
The coverage table references a non‑existent task “T017”, creating a stale tag that cannot be traced to any implementation.
